mapper.select:
SELECT p.* FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status = 'ENABLED' )
AND p.category_id IN
#{categoryId}
AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_sku s2 WHERE s2.product_id = p.id AND s2.status = 'ENABLED' AND s2.price >= #{minPrice} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_sku s3 WHERE s3.product_id = p.id AND s3.status = 'ENABLED' AND s3.price <= #{maxPrice} )
ORDER BY
(SELECT MIN(s4.price) FROM product_sku s4 WHERE s4.product_id = p.id AND s4.status = 'ENABLED') ASC, p.id ASC
(SELECT MAX(s5.price) FROM product_sku s5 WHERE s5.product_id = p.id AND s5.status = 'ENABLED') DESC, p.id DESC
p.sort_order DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
